mapper.sql: select w.id, w.name, w.url, w.thumbnail, w.folder, (select count(1) from px_like_record lr where lr.item_id = w.id and lr.type = '3') as like_count, w.width, w.height, w.`order`, w.del_flag, w.version, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, w.remark from px_wallpaper w
mapper.select: with recursive folder_tree as ( select id as sub_id from px_wallpaper_folder where id = #{folderId} and del_flag = 0 union all select f.id as sub_id from px_wallpaper_folder f inner join folder_tree ft on f.parent_id = ft.sub_id where f.del_flag = 0 ) select w.id, w.name, w.url, w.thumbnail, w.folder, (select count(1) from px_like_record lr where lr.item_id = w.id and lr.type = '3') as like_count, w.width, w.height, w.`order`, w.del_flag, w.version, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, w.remark from px_wallpaper w inner join folder_tree ft on w.folder = ft.sub_id where w.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY w.update_time DESC
